headline: Cabinet approval expected soon to deregulate oil prices, says Ahad Chima | Express News
summary: Cabinet approval for deregulating oil prices is expected soon, according to Minister Ahad Chima. A Gunvor Group delegation met the Minister of Economic Affairs and expressed interest in upgrading its refineries.
why: Oil price deregulation changes how fuel prices are set in Pakistan, affecting inflation and fuel importers. Gunvor is a major global commodities trader and refiner.
